main.description: Remove the caller's contact email. Their preferences space keeps a contact record with no address, so sign-in does not write one back, and every proof and open link is forgotten. The address on their PDS account is untouched. Customers and staff; anyone else is refused.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per action and resends on every retry of it.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden

errors.name: InvalidRequest
